harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 6 requests of probe.py 34 (eighth build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions: THE DIAGNOSTIC OF THE WAIT BEHIND ONE PRODUCER for two more producers - `LDS.128 R32, [R9+0x20]` waited by a reader of its THIRD register, `MOV R24, R34` (f_l128), and `LDCU.64 UR12, c[0x0][0x380]`, a 64-bit load into a uniform pair, waited by the reader of its low word (f_lcu64). The producer alone on write barrier 1, its destination holding a marker from the top of every iteration, the word that carries the wait as the NEXT word behind it, the producer's stall count swept (1 ... 8 cycles = the distance of the waiting word); three variants: f_<x> = no word carries the yield flag; f_<x>_y = THE PRODUCER carries the yield flag (the waiting word never does); f_<x>_n = the control without barrier and wait (the reader 1, 2, 4, 8, 15 and 30 cycles behind the word). Fronts: no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front - on a Workstation Edition card, the probe alone

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
conditions.card_state: a Workstation Edition card with its standing memory clock offset of +5000 MHz; the probe alone, no power limit

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
